$comment: Conservative example. Copy into target repos as .claude/settings.json (or merge into ~/.claude/settings.json). Verify keys/matcher syntax against your Claude Code version's docs.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json; c=json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''); bad=[w for w in ('git push','--force','rm -rf','git merge','checkout main','checkout master','reset --hard') if w in c]; (print('Blocked by claude-master hook: '+','.join(bad), file=sys.stderr), sys.exit(2)) if bad else sys.exit(0)"
